base_info.description: Mean of all 100 m AGB grid cells with centres within 1 km great-circle distance of the site, including zero grid cells, converted from Mg ha-1 with a factor of 47 for a carbon fraction of 0.47. Map year Y is placed on the last time step of Y.

agb.nameLong: Above-ground biomass from ESA CCI Biomass v7.0, mean within 1 km

agb_merged.nameLong: Above-ground biomass, in situ where available else ESA CCI v7.0
agb_merged.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET BADM and ESA CCI Biomass AGB v7.0
agb_merged.description: agb_De2026_consolidated.csv at sites with any in-situ value, otherwise the ESA CCI value. Sites are not mixed between sources.

agb_merged_PFT.nameLong: Above-ground biomass, in situ else ESA CCI v7.0, fixed to 100 gC m-2 for GRA, CRO and WET sites
agb_merged_PFT.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET BADM and ESA CCI Biomass AGB v7.0
agb_merged_PFT.description: agb_merged with every value at sites whose PFT is in pft_fixed set to agb_fixed, keeping the time stamps
